reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004EAD20 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/define/004EAD20-DefineGraph.cpp at sha256 034557e01b09c77c764e1f059cb4be96603b70f625ec893307a3e870b9586602 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t DefineGraph(long param_1, long param_2, long param_3, long param_4, long param_5, long param_6, int32_t param_7, void* param_8, float param_9);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0, long double arg2 @ st1, long double arg3 @ st2, long double arg4 @ st3, long double arg5 @ st4, long double arg6 @ st5, int32_t arg7, void* arg8, float arg9)" at 0x004EAD20; radare2 recovers "fcn.004ead20 (int32_t arg_1cch_2, int32_t arg_1c4h, int32_t arg_1cch);". Both tools place the entry at 0x004EAD20 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t DefineGraph(long param_1, long param_2, long param_3, long param_4, long param_5, long param_6, int32_t param_7, void* param_8, float param_9);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
